{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Aye!'' That'll be the ''peace convoy'' to Armath led by ''Ambassador Zell! Prepare to attack!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Reddjak]]|<ref name="Droids 3" />}}
Circa [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="DRA1" /> [[Zell]], an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Majoor]], led a '''peace mission''' to the planet [[Armath]].<ref name="Droids 3" />

However, the mission was curtailed when Zell's own son, [[Llez]], freed the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Reddjak]] from the [[Majoor penitentiary]] out of a romanticized notion of piracy. Upon learning that his benefactor was the son of the ambassador, Reddjak decided to ambush Zell's [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Starship/Legends|ships]].<ref name="Droids 3" />

Nevertheless, the timely intervention of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], hired by Zell to watch Llez in his absence, along with Zell's own confrontation of the pirates, led to Reddjak's recapture and allowed the mission to Armath to continue.<ref name="Droids 3" />
